capabilities: Scores workload pressure for the latest 30 days
Groups late departures into six time ranges, including overnight work
Charts departure trends, reference lines and a 30-day heatmap
Imports attendance records from JSON files, code blocks or pasted text
Exports sanitized JSON backups and rolls back import batches
disambiguation: Not a time tracker; it only charts attendance records you import or enter yourself.
extras: Only the internal JD attendance format is supported for import; other formats need a custom parser and adapter. Desktop backups are written to the Downloads folder, mobile backups stay in a vault folder.
problem: Attendance exports are hard to read inside Obsidian, with no view of late departures, overnight shifts, weekend work, or workload pressure over time.
summary: Offline dashboard that scores workload pressure and charts late departures, overnight and weekend attendance from imported local records.
